authorization: User approved new training-window/loss study on 2026-11-18
task: 57 stations; three separate nonoverlapping 24-hour rainfall totals issued daily at19h Vietnam
source: frozen temporal-study rows; use only N0/N1/N3, no new satellite/ERA5 labels
boundaries: retain original year-qualified windows and conservative purges; no window added between years
calibration_role: probability calibration and warning cutoff only; never tree weights or early stopping
retrospective: 2026 legacy and modern separately; already seen, partial year, exploratory only
prospective: new input snapshots and predictions recorded before issue; future truth only after target end

tuning.selection: one shared candidate minimizes mean normalized macro RMSE over both losses/all folds/all horizons
tuning.final_rounds: per-horizon median best iteration across both losses and four folds at shared candidate
tuning.final_loss: choose objective for long-window ablation/prospective only from training-only CV at shared candidate
tuning.auxiliary_heads: reuse old train-only candidate/rounds for median, wet, conditional; same by training window

ablation.N3: alias of B or D; do not refit alias

probability.calibration: Platt per seed/head on2025; leave-quarter-out with7day gap for cutoff
probability.cutoff: one shared cutoff for1/50 per configuration/horizon
probability.objective_effect: A/C share auxiliary heads and calibrated probabilities; B/D share them

targets.primary: conditional mean, assessed by station-macro RMSE
targets.secondary: conditional median assessed by station-macro MAE; dry/heavy bias; BS/BSS and POD/FAR/CSI

weighting: uniform training rows; equal-station macro reporting
bss_reference: CLIM_LONG for every model on exactly the same rows

uncertainty.correction: Bonferroni simultaneous95%CI plus Holm centered-bootstrap approximate p
uncertainty.status: exploratory retrospective; corrections do not undo prior examination of2026

label_policy: no deletion/repair based on model residuals or extreme rainfall
prospective_candidates: record all four A-D plus train-CV-selected long model; never select using2026 scores
live_truth: same namespace as input; complete24h each day, sum QC, no cross-channel splicing
